blocks.text: De fleste bær og frugter med sten holder ikke længe, når de er rå. Vil du gemme dem, så sylt, tør eller frys dem.

sourceRef.quote: De færreste bær- og stenfrugter holder særligt længe i deres rå form, men bør syltes, tørres, fryses eller på anden måde behandles eller opbevares, så de kan holde i længere tid.

blocks.text: Stikkelsbær er nært beslægtet med ribs og solbær og kan være grønne, hvidlige, gule eller røde til næsten sorte.

sourceRef.locator: Currant, Gooseberry, and Elderberry chapter, Scientific Name and Introduction, p. 306
sourceRef.quote: Currants and gooseberries are closely related, berry‑bearing deciduous shrubs in the Ribes L. genus of the Saxifragaceae family. … A gooseberry fruit may be green, white (gray‑green), yellow, or shades of red from pink to purple to almost black.

blocks.text: Litchi har en tynd, sej rød skal. Det spiselige, gennemsigtige frugtkød omgiver en stor sort kerne. Skallen bliver hurtigt brun, når frugten taber vand.

sourceRef.locator: Litchi chapter, Scientific Name and Introduction; Physiological Disorders, pp. 392–393
sourceRef.quote: has a thin leathery red skin with blunt or sharp spines. The edible, translucent-opaque flesh (aril) encloses a large (occasionally small), black seed. … The major disorder is the rapid browning of the shell from a bright red color (Paull and Chen 1987, Holcroft and Mitcham 1997). The browning is associated with water loss and injury (insect stings).

blocks.text: Kirsebær holder sig bedst i køleskabet ved 2–6 grader, hvor de kan holde 2–3 dage.

sourceRef.quote: Kirsebær holder sig bedst i køleskabet ved 2-6 grader. Kirsebær kan holde sig i 2-3 dage.

blocks.text: Søde kirsebær tåler kulde og bør opbevares så koldt som muligt uden at fryse: −1 til 0 °C og over 95 % luftfugtighed. Hold dem kolde, men ikke våde – konstant fugt på skindet kan få dem til at revne.

sourceRef.locator: Cherry (Sweet) chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions; Retail Outlet Display Considerations; Chilling Sensitivity, pp. 282–283
sourceRef.quote: Recommended conditions for storage of sweet cherries are -1 to 0 ºC with RH at over 95%. … Fruit should be refrigerated but not wetted because continuous moisture on the surface can cause splitting. … Sweet cherries are not sensitive to chilling and should be stored as cold as possible without freezing.

blocks.text: Stikkelsbær tåler kulde og opbevares bedst ved −0,5 til 0 °C og 95 % luftfugtighed – eller 0–1 °C for at undgå, at de fryser.

sourceRef.locator: Currant, Gooseberry, and Elderberry chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 307
sourceRef.quote: Since currant, gooseberry, and elderberry are not chilling sensitive, the recommended storage temperature and RH for all three are ‑0.5 to 0 °C (31 to 32 °F) with RH of 95% … Batzer and Helm (1999) recommended slightly warmer temperatures of 0 to 1 °C (32 to 34 °C) for red currant and gooseberry

blocks.text: Litchi opbevares bedst ved 2–5 °C og 90–95 % luftfugtighed, gerne i en pose eller lukket beholder. Ligger de frit i luften, bliver skallen hurtigt brun.

sourceRef.locator: Litchi chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions; Retail Outlet Display Considerations, p. 392
sourceRef.quote: Storage at 2 to 5 °C (36 to 41 °F) with 90 to 95% RH should result in 3 to 5 weeks of storage life. … Litchi should be displayed refrigerated, preferably in polystyrene containers or plastic bags. If litchi are left directly exposed to ambient air, the skin will rapidly brown.

blocks.text: Kirsebær har en tynd vokshinde og skrumper let. Hurtig nedkøling og fugtig luft mindsker vandtabet. Stød og tryk giver bløde, indsunkne pletter, som ofte først ses senere.

sourceRef.quote: Sweet cherries are also prone to shrivel and water loss due to the lack of a well-developed cuticle. Water loss can be minimized by prompt cooling and storage in a high-RH environment. … Visual symptoms of pits and bruises often do not appear until well after the fruit have been packed

blocks.text: Sortér litchi omhyggeligt før opbevaring, og fjern beskadigede eller rådne frugter.

sourceRef.locator: Litchi chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 392
sourceRef.quote: Fruit need to be carefully sorted before storage to remove any damaged or decayed fruit or fruit with insect stings

blocks.text: Kirsebær danner meget lidt ethylen (en gas, som frugt og grønt selv afgiver, og som får dem til at modne), men ethylen udefra får dem til at ånde hurtigere og miste kvalitet.

sourceRef.locator: Cherry (Sweet) chapter, Ethylene Production and Sensitivity, p. 283
sourceRef.quote: Sweet cherries produce very low amounts of ethylene but will respond to exogenous or wound- induced ethylene with increased respiration and quality loss.

blocks.text: Litchi danner meget lidt ethylen. Ethylen udefra kan måske få frugtkødet til at blive dårligt tidligere.

sourceRef.locator: Litchi chapter, Ethylene Production and Sensitivity, p. 393
sourceRef.quote: Litchi have a low rate of ethylene production: <1 nL kg-1 h-1. … Ethylene may lead to early aril deterioration.

blocks.text: Ved −1 til 0 °C holder søde kirsebær god kvalitet i 2–4 uger.

sourceRef.locator: Cherry (Sweet) chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 282
sourceRef.quote: Sweet cherries maintain good quality for 2 to 4 weeks under these conditions.

blocks.text: Stikkelsbær holder ca. 3 uger, når de køles ordentligt.

sourceRef.locator: Currant, Gooseberry, and Elderberry chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 307
sourceRef.quote: With proper cooling, the storage duration can be 1.5 , 2.5, and 3 weeks for black currant, red currant, and gooseberry, respectively

blocks.text: Litchi holder 3–5 uger ved 2–5 °C, men kun 3–5 dage ved 20 °C.

sourceRef.locator: Litchi chapter, Optimum Storage Conditions, p. 392
sourceRef.quote: Storage at 2 to 5 °C (36 to 41 °F) with 90 to 95% RH should result in 3 to 5 weeks of storage life. At 20 °C (68 °F) with 60% RH, fruit will last only 3 to 5 days.

blocks.text: Kirsebær: Vælg helt modne kirsebær, vask dem, og fjern stilke og sten. Dyp dem hele 30 sekunder i kogende vand, så skindet revner. De kan også lægges 10 minutter i vand med C-vitamin (ascorbinsyre). Lad dem dryppe godt af, og tør dem i ét lag, til de er seje som læder og let klæbrige (24–36 timer).

sourceRef.quote: Cherries Select fully ripe fruit. Wash well. Remove stems and pits. Dip whole cherries in boiling water 30 seconds to crack skins. May also dip in ascorbic acid or other antimicrobial solution for 10 minutes. Remove and drain well. Arrange in single layer on trays. Dry until tough, leathery, and slightly sticky (24-36 hours).

blocks.text: Bær: Vælg faste, modne bær, vask dem godt, og lad dem være hele eller halver dem. Bær med fast skind dyppes 30 sekunder i kogende vand, så skindet revner. Bløde bær (jordbær) lægges 10 minutter i vand med C-vitamin (ascorbinsyre). Lad dem dryppe godt af, og læg dem højst to lag dybt. Tør dem, til de er hårde og rasler, når bakken rystes (24–36 timer).

sourceRef.quote: Berries Select firm ripe fruit. Wash well. Leave whole or cut in half. For berries with firm skins, dip in boiling water 30 seconds to crack skins. For berries with soft skins (strawberries), dip in ascorbic acid or other antimicrobial solution for 10 minutes. Remove and drain well. Place on drying trays not more than two berries deep. Dry until hard and berries rattle when shaken on trays (24-36 hours).

blocks.text: Tør frugten i ét lag ved 60 °C i ovnen eller i et tørreapparat. Vend store stykker hver 3.–4. time. Frugten er tør, når den er sej og kan bøjes. Test det: Lad et par stykker køle af, og klem en håndfuld. Hånden skal være tør, og stykkerne skal falde fra hinanden, når du slipper.

sourceRef.quote: Arrange pretreated fruits on drying trays in single layers, pit cavity up. Dry at 140 degrees F (60°C) in an oven or dehydrator. … If possible, stir food and turn large pieces over every 3 to 4 hours during the drying period. … Dried fruits should be leathery and pliable. … Squeeze a handful of the fruit. If no moisture is left on the hand and pieces spring apart when released, they are dry.

blocks.text: Lad frugten hvile i 4–10 dage i en beholder med et løst låg, og ryst den hver dag. Så fordeles den sidste fugt. Kommer der små dråber på indersiden, skal frugten tørre mere. Opbevar den derefter i en tæt beholder, køligt, tørt og mørkt. Så holder den 6–12 måneder.

sourceRef.quote: Lightly cover and store in a warm, dry, well-ventilated place for four to 10 days. Stir or shake containers daily to separate pieces. If beads of moisture form inside, return food to drying trays for further drying, then repeat the conditioning step. … Store in a cool, dry, dark place or in the refrigerator or freezer. Properly stored, dried fruits keep well for six to 12 months.

blocks.text: Uden strøm kan du tørre frugt ude i solen. Det kan lade sig gøre, fordi frugt har meget sukker og syre. Det tager flere dage og kræver varmt, tørt vejr med vind: mindst 29 °C og helst ikke for fugtig luft (under 60 % luftfugtighed). Dæk frugten til, eller tag den ind om natten, så den ikke bliver fugtig igen.

sourceRef.quote: The high sugar and acid content of fruits make them safe to dry out-of-doors when conditions are favorable for drying. … To dry fruits out-of-doors hot, dry, breezy days are best. A minimum temperature of 85ºF is needed with higher temperatures being better. It takes several days to dry foods out-of-doors. … A humidity below 60 percent is best. … Fruits dried out-of-doors must be covered or brought under shelter at night. The cool night air condenses and could add moisture back to the food, thus slowing down the drying process.

blocks.text: Vælg modne, blanke kirsebær med ensartet farve. Fjern stilke, og vask dem. Stenene kan fjernes. Udstenede kirsebær lægges i vand med C-vitamin (ascorbinsyre). Kirsebær med sten prikkes med en ren nål på to sider, så de ikke revner. De kan henkoges i vand, æblesaft, hvid druesaft eller sukkerlage, med 1,3 cm fri plads øverst.

sourceRef.quote: Quality: Select bright, uniformly colored cherries that are mature (of ideal quality for eating fresh or cooking). … Procedure: Stem and wash cherries. Remove pits if desired. If pitted, place cherries in water containing ascorbic acid to prevent stem-end discoloration. If canned unpitted, prick skins on opposite sides with a clean needle to prevent splitting. Cherries may be canned in water, apple juice, white-grape juice, or syrup. … leaving ½-inch headspace.

blocks.text: Henkogningstid for søde eller sure kirsebær i vandbad op til 300 m over havet: varm fyldning (frugten kommer varm i glasset) – pint-glas 15 minutter, quart-glas 20 minutter. Rå fyldning – 25 minutter.

sourceRef.quote: Table 1. Recommended Process Time for Sweet or Sour Cherries, Whole in boiling-water canner. … Hot Pints 15 min 20 20 25 Quarts 20 25 30 35 Raw Pints or Quarts 25

blocks.text: Kirsebærsyltetøj med pektin: 4 cups finthakkede, udstenede kirsebær, 1 pakke pulverpektin og 5 cups sukker. Henkoges 5 minutter i vandbad med 6 mm fri plads.

sourceRef.quote: 4 cups ground or finely chopped pitted cherries (about 3 pounds or 2 quart boxes sour cherries) 1 package powdered pectin 5 cups sugar … leaving ¼ inch headspace. … Hot Half-pints or Pints 5 min

blocks.text: Hele bær (brombær, blåbær, ribs, solbær, stikkelsbær, hindbær m.fl. – kun de bær, opskriften nævner): Vælg modne, søde bær med ensartet farve. Vask dem, og fjern stilke. Stikkelsbær klippes i begge ender. Blåbær, ribs og stikkelsbær kan forvarmes 30 sekunder i kogende vand og fyldes på glas med varm saft. Alle bærrene kan også fyldes rå på glas og overhældes med varm sukkerlage, saft eller vand. Lad 1,3 cm være fri øverst.

sourceRef.quote: Blackberries, blueberries, currants, dewberries, gooseberries, huckleberries, loganberries, mulberries, raspberries. Use these directions only with the berries listed. … Quality: Choose ripe, sweet berries with uniform color. … Drain, cap, and stem if necessary. For gooseberries, snip off heads and tails with scissors. … Hot pack – For blueberries, currants, gooseberries, and huckleberries. Heat berries in boiling water for 30 seconds and drain. Fill jars and cover with hot juice, leaving ½-inch headspace. Raw pack – Fill jars with any of the raw berries, shaking down gently while filling. Cover with hot syrup, juice, or water, leaving ½-inch headspace.

blocks.text: Henkogningstid for hele bær i vandbad op til 300 m over havet: varm fyldning 15 minutter (pint- og quart-glas). Rå fyldning 15 minutter for pint-glas (ca. 0,5 liter) og 20 minutter for quart-glas (ca. 1 liter).
